messages:
Sara (Sales): Hi all — AcmeCorp POC is failing when we ask the model to emit deeply nested tool outputs (arrays of arrays of objects). Root error from their app: "Failed to parse function output: Expecting value at line 1 column 2". They also saw intermittent 429s. Can we triage? Also they asked about short Dedicated trial / credits to avoid throttling during POC.

Ben (Eng): Can you paste the raw function output and which model/version you're using? REST or SDK? streaming on/off? Also include any inference host logs (decode errors, truncation).

Sara (Sales): REST call, not streaming. Model: redwood/gpt-3.5x-mix (customer-picked). Raw output attached below (copied from their logs).

Acme QA: Here is the exact failing snippet we get from the tool output:

```
[
  {"action": "open_file", "path": "src/main.py"},
  ,
  {"action": "replace", "path": "src/lib.rs", "lines": [1,2,3]}
]
```

We see a stray comma after the first object and on some responses a leading UTF-8 BOM. Parser chokes.

Ben (Eng): OK that stray comma explains the JSON parse error. Two likely root causes: 1) model output drift producing malformed separators when nested arrays are large; 2) truncation mid-output from batching/limits. Check inference logs for decode/truncation. Any logs from the runtime?

Sara (Sales): We pulled logs from their request window. Excerpt: "inference-service.decode_error: Unexpected token at kv_cache.py:112" and DeployBot shows some 429s during the same minute.

DeployBot: Rate-limiter: client=acme-poc, policy=per-tenant-qps, window=60s, events: 429 x 3 between 1912345720-1912345740. Current qps=18/20.

Marta (Solutions): For nested tool outputs we usually recommend a top-level envelope to make parsing robust, e.g. `{"result": <your array>}` or returning base64-encoded payload. For POC short-term, enable the sanitizer config so the runtime strips BOMs and fixes trailing commas: `sanitize_json: true, tolerate_bom: true`.

Ben (Eng): Quick diagnostic steps I'm doing: 1) check if batching caused truncation (default token cap 2048), 2) confirm kernel/kv cache errors — kv_cache.py:112 points to an unexpected close while writing cache, could be memory pressure. Workaround: reduce max_batch_tokens or pin to dedicated pool.

Ben (Eng): Temporary hotfix we can toggle on the tenant: `tolerant_json=true` (runtime will attempt to repair common issues: remove BOM, drop dangling commas, and re-emit). I can push to a canary for acme-poc. ETA ~45m.

Sara (Sales): That would be great. Also the customer asked about pricing for function-heavy workloads — are function calls billed differently? They want an estimate if we move them to Dedicated for the week.

Marta (Solutions): Function outputs are billed token-wise same as normal generation. Dedicated gives stable throughput and avoids per-tenant rate-limits — pricing team can provide a short-term trial reserved bucket. I will loop in Account Exec. Security note: we support KMS/HSM and audit logs; default retention is 90 days but can be adjusted for enterprise deals.

Account Exec: I'll prepare a 2-week Dedicated trial quote and a small POC credit. Will follow up in email with terms.

Ben (Eng): Pushed canary toggle for tolerant_json to the staging instance for acme-poc. Logs during push: `deploy: canary toggle tolerant_json for tenant=acme-poc -> success`. Watch for repaired outputs. Also opened infra ticket #INF-4521 for kv_cache decode_error.

Acme QA: Thanks — after your change the last run looks cleaner, no stray comma. One sample good output: `[{\"action\":\"open_file\",\"path\":\"src/main.py\"},{\"action\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"src/lib.rs\",\"lines\":[1,2,3]}]` — parser accepted it.

Sara (Sales): Nice, thanks Ben and Marta. I'll update the customer and wait on Account Exec for trial/credit. cc @Account Exec. :thumbsup:

Ben (Eng): Follow-ups: I'll attach the infra ticket link and suggest they try shorter responses or envelope schema if they need deep nesting at scale. If 429s persist we should move them to a dedicated pool for the POC.

Marta (Solutions): I'll send a short best-practices note for structured outputs (schema hints + envelope example) and the security checklist (KMS, logs retention).

Sara (Sales): Great — closing this triage for now. Re-open if we see more decode errors or rate limits. :white_check_mark:
